newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising, rally to continue.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising, rally to continue.

text.p: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shares on Wednesday may continue their rally for a second day amid buying pressure by small investors, brokers said.
"The small investors may make fresh commitments as the prices are very attractive. Most of the shares dropped to a record low over the past several sessions," broker Mohammad Ullah said.
Brokers said the institutional investor state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) might lend support to prop up sentiment of small investors shaken by persistent bearishness.
The DSE benchmark index closed 36.14 points or 4.01 percent higher at 935.52 on Tuesday.
